notes: Concrete user tasks for the optional discovery-focused web interface evaluation (issue #31): understanding a discovery and its ranking explanation, running a budgeted discovery query, configuring interests, giving explicit feedback (item, query and discovery linkage), and reviewing story developments and edition history. Each task step names the shipped MCP tool that performs it; the replay drives the real tool surface over an in-memory transport with a recorded fake discovery provider. All timestamps are fixed; no provider, network or email is contacted.
